notes.title: STUNT BIKE EXTREME OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h1]The Launch Is Finally Here[/h1]

We're beyond excited to start a new chapter for Stunt Bike Extreme on Steam! Stunt Bike Extreme has gained amazing support and love as a mobile game, and now we are proud to share that joy with PC players!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3212130/Stunt_Bike_Extreme/


[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]400+ Levels[/b] and more with regular updates so you always have ramps to jump and stunts to land!
[*] [b]10+ Environments[/b] Take you from bustling cities to creepy swamps to test your skills in every environment
[*] [b]Bonus Tracks[/b] for the most Extreme Stunt Bike masters!
[*] [b]10+ Bikes with Customization[/b] To pick the right bike for the right job, or level up your favorite and dominate the tracks with it!
[*] [b]50+ Character Customization Options[/b] to perform your driving with your own look
[*] [b]Controller Support[/b]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292738/e1094ff35e495d7faf6786f5fae699dea51a1438.png[/img]


[h2]What To Expect?[/h2]
Feedback from demo has been invaluable to make Stunt Bike Extreme a great experience, and implementing feedback into our patches and updates will always be a priority. Expect regular fixes, updates and answers to feedback!
If you face issues or want to report a bug, the most direct and effective way is to email us at [b]support.stunt@hyperkani.com[/b]

[h3]Other Ways To Connect[/h3]
To chat with fellow Stunt Bike Fans and sometimes the Hyperkani Team, join our [b][url=https://discord.gg/xznkqehfsT]Discord[/url][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292738/4a73534f40e28591c9ab466f56117c4ff0a4f98a.png[/img]

You can also get your Stunt Bike Extreme news in our social media
[list]
[*] [url=https://www.facebook.com/stuntbikeextremegame]Facebook[/url]
[*] [url=https://www.instagram.com/stuntbikeextreme/]Instagram[/url]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45292738/dab98425b00127c3e062497bb8e1e2bb4490dbb6.png[/img]


[h2]Want To Share Your Opinion On Stunt Bike Extreme? Leave A Review![/h2]
Leaving a review on Steam is a [i]massive[/i] help. It directly helps us by sharing your critical feedback. It also brings more eyes to our game, and more feedback!
[b]Leave a review here ->[/b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3212130/reviews/]link[/url]


[h2]Thank You For Your Support![/h2]
- The Hyperkani Team

notes.title: Stunt Bike Extreme Demo is out!
notes.content:
Stunt Bike Extreme is the ultimate motocross racing game with awesome ramps to launch your bike high in the sky! Make sure to make some flips on your way down. Each track is different, and challenge your riding skills and strategic thinking. 

Test out 10 of our hand picked example tracks on this new demo! Drive through Junkyard, Hawaii, Swamp, Arizona and Winter environments among others. 

Full release coming in Spring 2025! Be sure to tap that wishlist button!

notes.title: Stunt Bike Extreme is coming to Steam!
notes.content:
We are working on releasing our popular motocross racing mobile game, Stunt Bike Extreme, on Steam. The demo will be available in March 2025!

Stunt Bike Extreme is the ultimate motocross racing game with awesome jump ramps, which make you fly high in the sky doing front flips and back flips. Each track is different and levels will not just challenge your bike skills but also your strategic thinking.

Full release coming in Spring 2025!
